metrics.window_convention: WP-12ad / S2b-2 uses the next prior contiguous equivalent-length evaluation window before REP-0013 / OL-0013: 2023-04-12 through 2024-04-11. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. No separate IS metric convention is introduced; in_sample.sharpe records the same actual window Sharpe for schema continuity.

data_provenance.source_data_notes: OL-0014 derives from REP-0014. REP-0014 used the next prior contiguous equivalent-length non-cloned evaluation window, covering 2023-04-12 through 2024-04-11. This window is distinct from REP-0011 full-period evidence, REP-0012 final-local-data-year evidence, and REP-0013 next-most-recent evidence.

notes: WP-12ae derives OL-0014 from REP-0014. It covers H-004 / research_oos / post_wp_5b / exp_success_criteria. gross_pnl > 0 and cost_drag_fraction are copied from REP-0014.
